videos.desc: In a cozy Pixar-style living room a woman scoops up her chubby orange cat, lifts it into the sunlight, hugs it tightly against her cheek and kisses its head while the cat squeezes its eyes shut contentedly.

A fruit bat hangs head-down from a cave roof, then opens and beats its big leathery wings; it drops into the air and beats them across a red sunset sky where a whole stream of bats is doing the same over the water.

A red hen pecks her way across a whitewashed courtyard and steps into a little wooden coop, settles down onto a ring of straw and shuffles into it; when she stands up a brown egg is lying in the straw, and a woman lifts it into her basket.

A woman shows a red ball to a golden retriever and throws it across the garden; the dog sprints after it under the apple tree, snaps it up in its mouth, trots the whole way back to her and drops it at her feet before rolling over for a belly rub.

A small otter rests its head and webbed paws on a person's bare arm, gazing into the camera. It snuggles against the person's sleeve, blinks sleepily and closes its eyes contentedly as a hand strokes its cheek.

A fluffy white cat and a black cat sit side by side on a concrete block by the shore, seen from behind, calmly watching the waves roll in at dusk. They stay pressed close together the whole time, tails hanging over the edge.

A fluffy grey kitten stands on a windowsill next to a wooden toy tower made of stacked spiral ramps, with bare winter trees outside the window. A small green ball rolls down the ramps and the kitten swats at it with one paw, then follows it round the tower to the bottom tray. It bats the ball again, rears up on its hind legs to reach the top ramp, and finally leans right over the top bowl and takes the ball in its mouth.

Filmed from the driver's seat through the windscreen of a safari vehicle on a dirt track in the bush, with the steering wheel and dashboard in the foreground. A single yellow banana has been stood upright on the bonnet. A large baboon walks along the bonnet towards it and sits down beside it; a second and then a third baboon climb up and sit in a row, all staring at the banana with more of the troop on the track behind. One of them finally reaches out, takes the banana and starts to eat it while the others crowd in around it.

An underwater shot in clear blue-green water with sunlight streaming down from the surface. A large great white shark swims straight towards the camera, head-on and filling the frame, its pale underside and pointed pectoral fins spread wide. As it comes closer the camera looks up into its face and its mouth opens slightly, showing the wide jaw lined with rows of triangular white teeth. At the last moment the shark turns and passes overhead, and the screen fills with churning white bubbles below the bright surface.

Two hands hold a small green parakeet that is wearing a tiny camera on its chest, sitting on someone's knee beside a road. Behind it a tall wooden pole carries power lines across a green field, and a huge untidy nest of sticks is balanced on top of the pole. The bird is let go and flies straight at the pole, the nest growing larger and larger until the bird slips in through a gap in the twigs. Inside the dark nest the camera passes through a tunnel of straw and comes out in a lit chamber where four young green parakeets sit around a small wooden table set with three little bowls of seed.

An underwater shot in clear blue water just above a white sandy seabed. A large tiger shark, its grey back marked with dark vertical bars, cruises slowly from left to right across the frame. A freediver in a bikini, mask and long fins swims down beside it, matching its speed, and reaches out with one hand. She lays her palm on the shark's back near the dorsal fin and runs it slowly along the animal's flank as the two glide side by side over the sand. She keeps her hand on it for several seconds before the shark turns away.

An animated autumn park with orange trees and benches. A plump teal and purple pigeon stands with its eyes closed and a soft smile. A large angry white hen with a red comb stands over three yellow chicks and swings a wooden stick at the pigeon; the next shot shows the pigeon wide-eyed with the stick pressed across its beak. A yellow chick has fallen asleep tucked into the pigeon's blue chest feathers with the stick lying across it. The hen lowers the stick and walks off with her chicks, and the teal pigeon turns to a white and pink pigeon beside it, their wings touching.

A simple cartoon set in a dark blue house at night. A mosquito with an angry face hovers by a door next to a glowing red plug-in insect repeller, then next to a wall socket, unbothered by it. It flies on to a bedroom where a person sleeps under a blue blanket with the crescent moon in the window, and lands on the sleeper's bald head. In close-up the mosquito braces its legs and drives its long proboscis down to bite. The last shot is the little white house from outside.

A black Labrador puppy is in a kitchen doorway behind an orange cardboard screen. On a flat sheet of cardboard in front of it stands a single upright sausage, with small dark plastic figures beside it. The puppy peeps around the orange screen at the sausage and holds still for a long time, only watching and edging closer. After several seconds it finally gives in, lunges forward, takes the sausage in its mouth and chews it, then sits back on the cardboard with its mouth open and only a hole left where the sausage stood.

The camera looks straight down into a big grey wheelie bin standing on a path in front of green bushes. A raccoon is sitting at the bottom of the bin next to a crumpled green rubbish bag. It looks up at the camera, then stands up on its back legs and stretches both front paws up the smooth inside wall, trying to get out. It slips back down, turns around and curls up, then sits up again and stares at the camera.

An animated cartoon. A small fluffy beaver-like animal with big round eyes falls backwards through a nest of sticks, then tumbles through a grey sky far above the ground. It lands flat on its face on the scaly grey head of an enormous reptile that is floating in a misty lake in front of a pine forest. The little animal sits up, sees the reptile's huge yellow eye opening right under it, and screams with its mouth wide open before running away over the water.

An animated scene split half above and half below the surface of a bright turquoise sea, with rocky islands in the background. A small brown otter clings to a green bamboo pole that stands straight up out of the water. Behind it a huge grey fish with a wide grin and heavy eyelids floats at the surface, filling most of the frame. The big fish sinks slowly out of sight below the otter, then rises again grinning, and finally disappears completely, leaving the little otter alone hugging the pole.

A grey wolf steps out of dense dark leaves onto a stony riverbank and comes slowly towards the camera with its head low. The shot cuts to a close-up of a brown hen, then to two yellow chicks beside a green bamboo tube on the gravel. Back on the wolf, it lies down with its muzzle flat on the wet stones, its amber eyes still following what is happening in front of it.

A hen crosses a rope bridge over a deep canyon with a row of yellow chicks tucked along her wings. A big grey wolf comes onto the planks behind her with its teeth bared and runs her down. The bridge gives way: the hen is left hanging from the rope by one wing while the wolf drops away into the mist below. She pulls herself back up and walks on across the bridge towards the sunrise.

A hen carries three yellow chicks in her wings out of a burning barn, beating her wings at the flames in the doorway. Later, under a full moon over a pine forest, the three chicks sit alone on the grass while mice and a red fox creep out of the dark towards them. The hen plants herself in front of the chicks and spreads both wings wide to block the way.

In deep snow at sunset a brown hen creeps low along a drift past a pile of sleeping wolves, one of them curled around a pale egg-shaped stone. She burrows into the snow until only her red comb shows above the surface, waits there, and then stands up covered in snow with a hard stare. The last shot has her out in the open on the pink snow, facing two wolves between bare black trees.

Inside a dark burrow a yellow chick holds a glass jar with a single firefly glowing inside it, and the small flame of the insect lights up its face and its huge eyes. The chick carries the jar to the round mouth of the burrow and looks out at a whole forest filled with thousands of drifting sparks under a full moon. The hen comes and stands beside it in the glow.

A hen pecks along a trail of yellow corn spilled over snowy boards beside a wooden fence and squeezes through the gap. She then looks down into a round hole dug in the earth, with a small blue-grey mouse standing at the bottom looking up, and pushes the corn down into it. At the bottom of the hole a family of mice gathers round a big heap of corn lit by a candle.

An elderly woman in a pink shirt walks a full-grown alligator on a red leash down a tiled colonnade in the sun. A young man carrying a small black puppy stops her and points out that the animal on the leash is an alligator and that her actual dog is right there in his arms. She looks down at it, says she forgot her glasses, and carries on walking.
videos.said: What are you doing? I'm walking the dog. That's an alligator. Your dog is right here. Oh, I forgot my glasses.

videos.desc: A bald eagle glides low straight towards the camera over flat grey-green sea water, with a dark forested shore behind it. It holds its wings out wide and drops its yellow feet, watching the surface. As it reaches the camera it swings its talons forward, skims the water, and lifts away with a silver fish gripped in both feet, water spraying behind it.

A shirtless man in neon green swim shorts stands over a shark stranded in the wet sand at the edge of a turquoise sea. He grips it by the tail, hauls it backwards through the shallow water until it is deep enough to swim, lets go, and steps back to watch it move off on its own into the waves.

A hamster stands on a sunlit wooden kitchen counter with a chocolate-coated ice cream bar in each paw. It keeps the two bars up in front of its face, hiding everything but its ears and whiskers, and holds them there while the sun comes through the window behind it. Then it brings them down and holds them up and out to either side, grinning wide at the camera, with a bite taken out of the bar on the right.

Filmed from the back of a huge scaled animal, as a rider would see it. The creature is dark red and black with rows of spines down its neck, horns on its head and an amber eye, and it stands on a cliff above a fjord with a leather saddle and harness strapped over its shoulders. It turns its head, then throws itself off the cliff; the shot dives with it down a gorge past a waterfall, skims low over the water between rock walls, and flies on through fog towards a distant spired castle.

A small green cartoon gecko stands in a bright circle of light, seen as if through a peephole. It raises one hand and waves at the camera, then breaks into a dance, spinning and throwing its arms out. It settles, folds its arms across its chest and grins with its eyes shut, then leans right up to the lens until its face fills the frame.

A huge dinosaur crouches at the muddy edge of a jungle river below a tall waterfall and lowers its head to drink. Under the brown water a giant crocodile glides straight towards the camera with its jaws closed. The crocodile explodes out of the shallows in a wall of spray and locks onto the dinosaur, which rears up on its hind legs with the thrashing crocodile hanging from it. A wide shot shows more crocodiles cutting through the water towards the struggle.

A snow monkey with a red face sits hunched on a snowy wooden railing in a forest, sealed inside a thick shell of clear ice that covers its whole body. A person in a dark blue coat and yellow work gloves leans in and taps at the ice with a small hammer. The shell cracks, and the person lifts the whole hollow casing of ice off the monkey and holds it up, dripping with icicles. Underneath, the monkey shakes itself out on the railing, loose and dry.

Inside a long barn with grey metal stalls down both sides of a concrete aisle, a toddler in jeans and a cream jumper toddles up to a wooden crate full of carrots and pulls one out. He carries it down the aisle, holding it up in the air, to where a black horse has its head out over a stall door. The horse stretches down and takes the carrot from his hand, and the little boy claps his hands and laughs.
videos.said: Give it to Verspy. Good job, buddy.

videos.desc: In a carpeted living room next to a white curtain, one husky rolls on its back with its paws in the air while a second husky stands over it, nosing at it. The two of them then stand side by side facing each other, almost identical black and white dogs with the same markings and the same pale blue eyes. One lifts a paw and paws at the other's chest. The camera closes in on one of them looking straight into the lens.

Filmed from inside a car at sunset. On a gravel track beside a wooden fence a big brown longhorn bull walks along with a small white dog next to it, kicking up dust. The bull turns on the dog and they tumble together in a cloud of dust. Cut to two young men in the car, mouths wide open screaming and laughing. The bull then runs straight down the track towards the car, horns forward, and pushes its huge shaggy head right up against the open car window until its nose and horns fill the whole frame.

A grey kangaroo stands upright on a green hillside pasture under a grey sky, with gum trees and a fence in the distance. A person's hand reaches in from the side and scratches the kangaroo's chest and neck with the fingers. The kangaroo half closes its eyes and leans into the hand, then slowly sinks down and lies flat out on the grass, stretching its long back legs and heavy tail behind it while the hand keeps scratching its head and neck.
